Rationale: Waiyan Start1 Grade-3 upper lists fast food as an explicit headword inside a food sequence with hamburger, chips and food, and directly glosses it as the noun 快餐/速食. The compound therefore forms one stable elementary food learning unit rather than an underspecified open construction.

Waiyan Start1 Grade-3 lower places physical education in a school-subject sequence beside English, PE, Chinese and art, and directly glosses it as 体育教学. This fixes the full-form school-subject learning unit; the separate abbreviation PE remains governed by abbreviation/canonical-form policy.

The Grade-1 source gloss gives only the cat-vocalization concept, as both action and sound (猫叫 / 猫叫声). The noun/verb POS difference does not create distinct elementary meanings, matching the already accepted sound/action boundary used for woof, beep and chug.
